hyperponder.ponder.muteki.text_1: Keep the Muteki Star in your hotbar and you become Muteki.
hyperponder.ponder.muteki.text_2: Command selectors such as @e can no longer pick you.
hyperponder.ponder.muteki.text_3: Your items cannot be stolen either.
hyperponder.ponder.muteki.text_4: It also ignores the Novel Calibur's instant kill.
hyperponder.ponder.novel.text_1: Left-click and every entity near your line of sight is defeated.
hyperponder.ponder.novel.text_2: While sneaking, only the single entity you are looking at is defeated.
hyperponder.ponder.novel.text_3: Rare drops, experience orbs and enchantment effects still work.
hyperponder.ponder.novel.text_4: It can also be used as a modifier in Tinkers' Construct.
hyperponder.ponder.chronicle.text_3: The region between them becomes protected.
hyperponder.ponder.chronicle.text_4: Inside, players can only touch things as if they were in Adventure mode.
hyperponder.ponder.chronicle.text_5: By default only the owner can act inside. A paused region blocks even the owner.
hyperponder.ponder.chronicle.text_6: Left-click the region to release the protection.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_1: Left-click a block to mine it instantly.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_2: Right-click a start and an end point to create a combo chain.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_3: Mining a block inside the chain mines the whole chain at once.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_4: Middle-click a chain to make a combo cluster. Sneak and right-click to dissolve it.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_5: Drops go straight into your inventory; otherwise they are stored inside the item.
hyperponder.ponder.paradox.text_6: Throw the item to deliver its contents to the storage you are looking at.
hyperponder.ponder.vrx.text_1: Right-click a block or an entity to open its VRX.
hyperponder.ponder.vrx.text_2: Set the contents in the GUI and close it to give the VRX to the target.
hyperponder.ponder.vrx.text_3: Left-click a block or an entity to dissolve its VRX.
hyperponder.ponder.vrx.text_4: Right-click the player inside the GUI to open your own VRX.
hyperponder.ponder.vrx.text_5: The contents can also be set from JEI or EMI when they are installed.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_summon.text_1: Build a T shape out of four Bone Souls, like a Wither.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_summon.text_2: Put the Right, centre and Left Fumetsu Skulls on top. The left and right ones may also be swapped.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_summon.text_3: Sneak and right-click the shape with the God Sigil.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_summon.text_4: The blocks vanish and the Fumetsu Wizard appears. The God Sigil is not used up.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_summon.text_5: This works only while summoning is enabled in the config. The spawn egg also calls it.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_defeat.text_1: The Fumetsu Wizard does not take the Novel Calibur's attacks, and ordinary attacks cannot kill it either.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_defeat.text_2: The basic way to defeat it is to reload it. When a player logs in, logs out, changes dimension, dies or respawns, the Wizard vanishes.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_defeat.text_3: This works while logging out is enabled in the config, which is the default.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_defeat.text_4: When it vanishes this way, it leaves 8 to 12 Bug Stars behind.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_rage.text_1: While calm, it just drifts around in the air.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_rage.text_2: When it is hurt, or its health drops at all, it gets angry. It never calms down again.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_rage.text_3: Angry, it targets every living entity around it at random. Players come first.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_rage.text_4: It fires skulls in three colours, and sometimes a huge skull.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_rage.text_5: Every few seconds it charges at its target and bursts as a Fumetsu Storm.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_rage.text_6: Very rarely it also uses a special annihilating attack.
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_immortal.head: The Fumetsu Wizard's Immortality
hyperponder.ponder.fumetsu_immortal.text: Its health never stays lowered. It is put back at once, and it also heals every second.
The death process itself is switched off, so ordinary damage and commands cannot kill it.
It also resists things that try to remove the entity, just like a Muteki player.
Even the Novel Calibur does not work on it. Only reloading it makes it vanish.
